coding.note: Codes the September 2024 release described in the abstract/introduction; Appendix I also describes the January 2025 update. Claims are deduplicated across those sections. Matched architecture comparisons include downstream performance curves, not only loss curves, so are YES; sparse upcycling is PARTIAL because it includes an additional 2T-token dense pretraining history. No independent same-setting seed replications are stated. FULL data disclosure is supported by Table 2 source-level token counts, filtering and epoch/shuffling details, and Table 3 adaptation sample counts. Comparator list is capped at 15, omitting Mistral-7B and DCLM-7B from Table 4. Rerun/scores_copied refer to the main results tables, whose captions explicitly say all evaluations were run by the authors. The comparison to other models on the AlpacaEval leaderboard does not establish an independent evaluation of OLMoE itself, so third_party is conservatively NO. Prior techniques retain their prior names; no renames identified.
